name: Member's Mark Long Grain Enriched White Rice (25 lb Bag)
whyItWorks: Standard polished white rice enriched with B vitamins and iron. Completely non-allergenic and low in residue, white rice absorbs fluids and calms gut spasms during acute Crohn's flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Steam thoroughly with 2 parts water to 1 part rice. Season with salt and a touch of butter or olive oil.
